scope: Add the official base-game launch event to the provenance registry without inferring individual skill release mappings or patch versions.

records.basis: Bandai Namco's official launch notice states DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 launched in the Americas on October 25, 2016 for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, with the Steam PC version launching October 27, 2016.

boundary.pc_release: Steam is separately dated October 27, 2016 in the same official notice.
boundary.skill_mapping: The launch event does not by itself prove which individual canonical skills shipped in the base game; no such assignments were inferred.

next: Continue release-provenance coverage into remaining early free updates and individual DLC skill mappings where direct evidence exists.
